message.content:
**Uno – Quick Overview**

| Item | Details |
|------|---------|
| **Deck** | 108 cards (4 colors × 25 cards each + 8 special cards) |
| **Players** | 2–10 (standard rules work best with 2–6) |
| **Goal** | Be the first to score 500 points (or play all cards in a single round) |

---

### 1️⃣ Setup

| Step | Action |
|------|--------|
| 1 | Shuffle the deck. |
| 2 | Deal 7 cards to each player. |
| 3 | Place the remaining deck face‑down as the draw pile. |
| 4 | Turn the top card of the draw pile face‑up to start the discard pile. |
| 5 | If the first card is a special card, apply its effect immediately (e.g., if it’s a “Draw Two,” the first player draws two and loses their turn). |

---

### 2️⃣ Card Types

| Type | Symbol | Effect |
|------|--------|--------|
| **Number** | 0–9 | Match by color or number. |
| **Skip** | ❌ | Next player misses a turn. |
| **Reverse** | 🔁 | Reverses play direction. |
| **Draw Two** | ➕2 | Next player draws two cards and skips a turn. |
| **Wild** | 🎨 | Player chooses the next color. |
| **Wild Draw Four** | 🎨➕4 | Player chooses the next color; next player draws four cards and skips a turn. |

> **Note:** Wild Draw Four may only be played if the player has no matching color cards. If challenged and found to have a playable card, the challenger draws six cards instead.

---

### 3️⃣ Gameplay Loop

| Phase | What Happens |
|-------|--------------|
| **Turn** | Player may play one card that matches either the color or the symbol of the top discard. |
| **If no match** | Player draws one card from the draw pile. |
| **If drawn card is playable** | Player may play it immediately. |
| **If not playable** | Turn ends. |
| **Special card effects** | Apply immediately after being played (skip, reverse, etc.). |
| **End of turn** | Check if the player has zero cards left. |

---

### 4️⃣ Winning a Round

| Condition | Points Awarded |
|-----------|----------------|
| **Player discards last card** | Opponents sum of all cards in hand (number cards = face value; Skip/Reverse/Draw Two = 20; Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50). |
| **First to 500 points** | Wins the game. |

---

### 5️⃣ Common Variations

| Variation | How It Works |
|-----------|--------------|
| **House Rules** | e.g., “Draw Two” can be stacked, “Wild Draw Four” can be challenged. |
| **Speed Uno** | Play without drawing; players must play a card or lose a turn. |
| **Uno Attack** | Uses a special electronic card dispenser. |

---

### 6️⃣ Quick Tips

| Tip | Why It Helps |
|-----|--------------|
| **Keep a balanced hand** | Having multiple colors reduces the chance of being stuck. |
| **Save Wilds** | Use them strategically when you’re low on cards or to change the flow. |
| **Watch opponents’ colors** | Helps anticipate which cards they might play next. |

---

**Enjoy your game!**
